name: hud_ui_mgr_sensor_track_list_reset
description: HudUiMgrSensor::TrackList_Reset clears the global sensor track-list state.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly at 0x41ebd0/0x41ebe0 shows four zero stores to g_HudUiMgrSensor_TrackList fields at 0x4f3340..0x4f334c and return; HLIL renders this as memset(&g_HudUiMgrSensor_TrackList, 0, 0x10).
The typed HudUiMgrSensorTrackList global is already modeled with 16-byte size and field offsets through player.h static asserts; no external authored dependency remains for this reset helper.
The native smoke seeds every track-list field, calls TrackList_Reset, and verifies auxiliary, head, tail, and count fields are all zeroed.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x41ebd0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
